Highlight Clip: Tom Lee: BitMine Completes the Largest Share Buyback in Crypto Industry History Tom Lee: BitMine Completes the Largest Share Buyback in Crypto Industry History On October 7, 2026, BitMine Chairman Tom Lee stated that the company repurchased a total of 21 million shares worth $350 million between July 14 and August 17. He described it as the largest share buyback in crypto industry history, noting that the program helped establish a floor for the stock price. In addition, BitMine accumulated nearly 6 million ETH during the bear market, bringing it close to its goal of holding 5% of Ethereum's total supply. Year-to-date in 2026, ETH has declined 9%, while BitMine shares have gained 3%, outperforming ETH. — link

PancakeSwap Proposes Raising LP Fee Share to 88% and Cutting Daily CAKE Emissions 69% PancakeSwap’s Kitchen has proposed raising the LP share of swap fees to 88% on v3 and Infinity across all 11 chains, with the remaining 12% going to the Treasury. v2 would stay unchanged. Based on 2025 volume, LPs would receive an estimated $62 million more in fees. Trader rates would not change, but liquidity depth is projected to rise by up to 30% and price impact to fall 20–25%. Daily CAKE emissions would fall from 22,500 to 7,000, a roughly 69% cut, with the 7,000 going to the Pantry ecosystem growth fund. That would reduce annual minting by about 5.7 million CAKE. Supply has already fallen 11.5% since Tokenomics 3.0 in April 2025, and the plan aims to keep a roughly 20% supply cut by 2030. Implementation is planned to start in November 2026, within two weeks of the proposal passing, and finish by the end of January 2027. It is still in discussion and will go to a Snapshot vote. — link

France Considers 31.4% Tax on Crypto-to-MiCA Stablecoin Conversions From 2027 The French parliament is reviewing the 2027 budget and considering a 31.4% capital gains tax on conversions of crypto into MiCA-regulated stablecoins from Jan. 1, 2027, CoinDesk reported. Chainalysis France CEO Francois Volpoet warned the measure could push traders toward non-MiCA stablecoins and harder-to-monitor offshore channels. The finance committee approved related amendments on Oct. 7 and on Oct. 9 backed rules requiring declaration of self-custodied wallets holding at least €100k and inclusion of crypto in the exit tax. It later rejected the government’s 2027 revenue section by 31 votes to 3, sending the crypto tax amendments back to the full National Assembly. A revenue vote is expected on Oct. 20. None of the measures is law yet. — link

Kraken Parent Payward to Acquire EU-Regulated Lithuanian Bank Saldo Kraken’s parent company Payward has announced plans to acquire Saldo Bank, an EU-regulated bank in Lithuania, to expand into traditional banking services such as lending and card issuance, the Financial Times reported. The price was not disclosed. The deal is expected to close in 2027 if it receives regulatory approval. Payward co-CEO Arjun Sethi said the company plans to integrate cash, crypto assets, tokenized stocks and credit, allowing customers to borrow without selling assets. Saldo Bank received its EU banking licence in 2021 and offers personal and business loans as well as term deposits. If completed, the transaction would make Payward the first digital-asset company to acquire a European bank. — link
